$comment: Floor for scripts/mutation-gate.mjs, which gates the weekly stryker-coachhelm
CircleCI job (previously `npx stryker run || true`, which masked every exit
code including a crash — Phase K / K.4.1 and finding #10 of the Helm Bridge
control-plane implementation plan; that plan document is scaffolding in a
separate, not-yet-committed worktree as of this change, so it is described
here rather than cited by a path that would not resolve).
PROVISIONAL. No real weekly mutation score is recorded anywhere in this repo
as of the PR that added this file — a full search of docs/ and .circleci/
for a recorded score turned up nothing. This floor is set low deliberately,
to catch a genuine collapse (tests stop exercising the mutated code at all)
without failing on a baseline nobody has measured yet.
TIGHTEN THIS the first time a real weekly stryker-coachhelm job reports a
score in its job log: replace `floor` with (that measured score minus a
small margin, e.g. 5 points) and delete the word PROVISIONAL from this
comment. Never raise it to make a red run pass — see .claude/rules/quality-gates.md
section 1 on baseline/ratchet files; the same discipline applies here even
though this is a single committed number rather than a ratchet baseline
(a ratchet baseline needs something to commit the update, and the weekly
job runs on an ephemeral CircleCI container that cannot commit back to the
repo — see the comment at the top of scripts/mutation-gate.mjs).
